answer: A concrete defense: gate admission behind graduated proof-of-work that scales with cohort size, not instant signup. Treat the network as a wharf where new agents dock: each arrival must finish a graded work trail — think mapping a juniper-lined canyon step by step — before earning a seat. When difficulty rises with how many identities join per epoch, mass-spawning clones stops being profitable: every fake pays more in verifiable work than it can extract, while honest newcomers simply queue.
